text.excerpt: Bran Castle, the Transfăgărășan, and three days at a cabin with no signal.
text.intro: The Transfăgărășan is the kind of road you plan a whole trip around, and it earned it. After that, three days at a cabin with no signal — which turned out to be the part everyone talks about now.
